name: nuvriqo-portal-plus
description: Nuvriqo Portal+ for Jira Service Management

scripts.build: nuvriqo-ui-copy static/admin/dist static/portal/dist && esbuild static/portal/src/app.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=static/portal/dist/app.js && esbuild static/portal/src/modules-runtime.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=static/portal/dist/modules-runtime.js && esbuild static/admin/src/app.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=static/admin/dist/app.js
scripts.test:integrations: node tests/integration-contract.test.mjs && node tests/integration-registry.test.mjs && node tests/integration-adapters.test.mjs && node tests/asset-manager-adapter.test.mjs && node tests/self-service-contract.test.mjs && node tests/self-service-runtime.test.mjs && node tests/self-service-admin.test.mjs && node tests/request-detail-security.test.mjs && node tests/request-detail-ui.test.mjs && node tests/ui-shell-structure.test.mjs && node tests/module-renderers.test.mjs && node tests/pre-marketplace-e2e.test.mjs && npm run test:behaviour
scripts.test:behaviour: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --no-warnings --test tests/customer-safety.test.mjs tests/admin-config.test.mjs tests/xlsx-writer.test.mjs tests/licensing.test.mjs tests/report-display.test.mjs tests/sla.test.mjs tests/help-centers.test.mjs tests/documents.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:ui && npm run release:check && npm run test:integrations
